header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.title: Open Heatloss Studio
header.desc: Open source heat loss calculation for buildings conforming to NEN 12831.

why.title: Why Open Heatloss Studio?
why.desc: Heat loss calculations are essential for the design of heating systems and building energy performance. Open Heatloss Studio offers an accessible, open source alternative to expensive commercial software, fully conforming to NEN 12831.
why.desc2: Built on a Rust calculation core for maximum speed and accuracy — thousands of rooms are calculated in seconds. Everything runs locally, no cloud dependency, your project data stays yours.

nen12831.title: NEN 12831 calculations
nen12831.desc: Full heat loss calculations conforming to NEN 12831. Accurate results for heating system design.

transmission.title: Transmission losses per room
transmission.desc: Detailed calculation of transmission losses per room, including correction factors for ground-coupled constructions.

ventilation.title: Ventilation losses
ventilation.desc: Calculation of ventilation losses based on ventilation system, air volume flow and infiltration.

ifcx.title: IFCX integration
ifcx.desc: Import building geometry and construction properties directly from IFCX models for faster input.

reports.title: Report generation
reports.desc: Generate clear reports with heat loss per room, total overviews and graphical representations.

library.title: Building physics library
library.desc: Extensive library with material properties, construction build-ups and standard U-values.

uvalue.title: U-value calculator
uvalue.desc: Calculate U-values of constructions layer by layer. Material library with λ-values conforming to NEN-EN 12524 and NTA 8800.

constructions.title: Construction build-ups
constructions.desc: Predefined construction build-ups (façades, roofs, floors) with automatic U-value. Create and reuse your own build-ups.

thermal.title: Thermal bridges
thermal.desc: Linear thermal bridges (Ψ) according to NEN-EN ISO 14683. Default values or detail-based calculation per junction.

ground.title: Ground-coupled constructions
ground.desc: Correction factors for floors on grade, basement walls, crawl spaces and adjacent unheated rooms (b-factors).

climate.title: KNMI climate data
climate.desc: Design indoor and outdoor temperatures per location. KNMI climate zones selected automatically from the postcode.

zones.title: Zoning
zones.desc: Group rooms by heating zone, controller or plant location. Different setpoints per zone are possible.

heatup.title: Heat-up allowance
heatup.desc: Calculation of the extra capacity needed to heat up after a night setback — in line with the tables in NEN 12831 Annex F.

radiator.title: Radiator sizing
radiator.desc: Determine radiator output per room from heat loss, water temperature and exponent. Selection from a manufacturer library.

floor.title: Underfloor heating
floor.desc: Underfloor heating output per room, with system temperature, pipe spacing and flow temperature.

heatpump.title: Heat pump sizing
heatpump.desc: Preliminary heat pump sizing based on total heat loss at design temperature. SCOP indication per type.

boiler.title: Boiler capacity
boiler.desc: Boiler capacity including domestic hot water, simultaneity factors and buffer volumes.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Real-time overview: total heat loss, loss per zone, top 10 rooms with the highest loss, energy indicators.

compare.title: Variant study
compare.desc: Compare several design variants side by side. What-if analyses for insulation, ventilation and solar orientation.

export.title: Exports
export.desc: Export to Excel (XLSX) for further analysis, IFCX for BIM integration, and JSON for automation and API links.

cli.title: CLI & batch
cli.desc: Command-line interface for batch calculations. Integrate into CI pipelines or automate across portfolios.

local.title: 100% local
local.desc: All calculations run locally on your own machine. No cloud, no tracking. Your project data stays yours.

crossplatform.title: Cross-platform
crossplatform.desc: Available for Windows, macOS, Linux and as a web application. Tauri 2 + Rust for maximum performance.

isso51.title: ISSO 51:2023
isso51.desc: Specific methodology for heat loss calculation of dwellings and residential buildings according to ISSO publication 51 (2023).

norm.title: Which standards are supported?
norm.desc: Open Heatloss Studio implements the official Dutch and European standards for heat loss calculations. Fully in line with the applicable methodologies for heating design and energy performance.
norm.list1: NEN-EN 12831-1:2017 — Energy performance of buildings, method for calculating the design heat load
norm.list3: ISSO 51:2023 — Heat loss calculation for dwellings and residential buildings
norm.list4: ISSO 53/57 — Methodologies for non-residential and complex buildings

tech.title: Technology
tech.desc: A Rust calculation core for the standards-compliant calculations, a TypeScript/SolidJS front-end for the interface, and Tauri 2 for cross-platform distribution. The same stack as the rest of the OpenAEC ecosystem, for seamless integration.
